en: The ritual manual for the Ten Deities:

For the seal of Maheśvara in the northeast, form a fist with the right hand and place it at the right hip; the five fingers of the left hand are held straight up, touching one another. Earth and Water.
Bend the middle joints of the two index fingers.
The fire, wind, and space [mudrās] are formed by keeping each of the three fingers slightly apart.
The mantra is as follows:
Namaḥ samantabuddhānāṃ oṃ iśānaye svāhā | Oṃ rudrāya svāhā | For the seal of Śakra, Lord of the East, the right hand is as described above.
The five fingers of the left hand are held upright and touching one another;

the earth and water fingers (the ring finger and middle finger) are bent at their middle joints, with the wind finger (the index finger) placed against the back of the fire finger (the little finger).
The empty fist with the middle joints bent. The mantra is:
Oṃ indrāya svāhā. Again: Oṃ cakreya svāhā. For the Seal of Agni, Lord of the Southeast, form a fist with the left hand and place it at the left hip.
The five fingers of the right hand are held straight up and touching one another;
the thumb is bent and placed within the palm,
with its middle joint bent.
To summon with *svāhā*. The mantra is: Oṃ ā o naye svāhā.
For the seal of Yama of the southern direction: first join the palms; then bend the middle joints of the two middle fingers so that their backs touch.
The two *vāyu* [fingers] are also bent back against [the palms].
By pressing the middle joints of each *vāyu* with the two thumbs, it is completed.
The mantra is as follows:
Oṃ yamāya svāhā. For the Rākṣasa deity of the southwest, the mudrā is formed by making a fist with the right hand and placing it at the waist;
the five fingers of the left hand are held upright and touching one another.
Bend the joints of the earth-hand within the water-hand.
Press the tips of the fingers of emptiness against the earth-hand, and the seal is immediately formed.
The mantra is as follows:
Oṃ dharitrīye svāhā. For the seal of Varuṇa, the deity of the western direction: the right hand is as described above;
the left hand forms a fist with the thumb not entering the palm.
For Vāyu, simply hold the middle joint upright and slightly bend it, and it is completed. The mantra is:
Oṃ vāruṇāya svāhā. For the seal of Vāyu in the northwest, the right hand is as described before.
The five fingers of the left hand are held upright and touching one another.
By bending the middle joints of the earth and water [fingers], it is formed.
The mantra is as follows:
Oṃ vāyave svāhā. For the mudrā of Vaiśravaṇa of the north: first join the palms with the ten fingers interlaced inside;
then extend the two index fingers (water-fingers) upright, their tips touching.
The two *vāyu* fingers are held upright and slightly bent;
the left [hand] is hollowed and inserted into the right palm,
pressing down upon the left *tejas* finger-nail.
The right [hand] passes through the space of the left and behind it;
it enters the left palm and presses down upon the right fire-armour.
The two winds and the syllable *ha* summon one another.
The mantra is: Oṃ Vaiśravaṇāya Svāhā. For the mudrā of Brahmā of the upper direction: form a fist with the right hand and place it at the right hip;
the five fingers of the left hand are joined together and held upright, slightly bent.
Its height is slightly more than the shoulders.
The mantra for the Lotus-Mark is: Oṃ mṛṇālini svāhā.
For the Seal of the Earth Deity of the Lower Direction: first join the palms; then, with the wind [element] fingers, press the tips of the four fingers together.
Open wide in front.
Place the two *śūnyatā* [syllables] on either side of the wind.
The mantra is as follows:
Oṃ pṛthivīye svāhā. The mudrā of the Sun Deity is no different from the previous earth mudrā;
however, one simply places the tips of the two thumbs on the lower joints of the ring fingers.
The mantra is: Oṃ aniye svāhā. The mudrā of the Moon Deity is the same as the previous Brahmā mudrā, except that one forms the appearance of a pure white moon within the palms.
The mantra is: Oṃ caṇḍālya svāhā. For the seal of the Seven Planets, first join the palms with the ten fingers touching one another;
then, the two wind-fingers and the two space-fingers are opened wide against each other.
The mantra is: *Nir-ā-hi śvāriye prapāta-sthira-maye svāhā*. For the mudrā of the twenty-eight lunar mansions (*nakṣatras*), first join the palms with the fingers hollowed out.
The two fire fingers interlace externally;
the two space fingers also interlace.
The mantra is as follows:
Namaḥ kṣetrādhipataye sujanāya svāhā. The Ritual Manual for the Ten Deities’ Offering.
